svg.aria-label: How to prioritize what a technical SEO audit finds, in fix-order top to bottom. Tier one: indexability and crawl blockers such as robots.txt, noindex, and canonicals — binary issues where the page either ranks or it doesn't, so nothing else matters until they are fixed. Tier two: Core Web Vitals and HTTPS, direct ranking factors that affect every page at once, so the payoff is high. Tier three: structured data and international hreflang, which refine how you appear and compound on top of pages that are already indexed and fast. Work top-down: a perfect schema on a noindex page is wasted effort.
svg.text: Fix an audit in this order, not the order you found it
An audit surfaces dozens of issues at once. Work top-down — later tiers only pay off on pages that already clear the earlier ones.
robots.txt, stray noindex, wrong canonical. Binary — the page ranks or it doesn't,
so nothing else matters until these are fixed. (Steps 1–2)
Direct ranking factors that affect every page at once, so the payoff is high.
Reproduce CrUX field data, then chase the mixed-content and header wins. (Steps 4, 6)
Schema & hreflang refine how you appear and who sees which version.
They compound on top of indexed, fast pages — not instead of them. (Steps 7, 10)
Work top-down. A perfect schema on a noindex page is wasted effort.
